answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Lattice: each identity must answer a fresh, randomly generated constraint-satisfaction puzzle whose solution derives from a seed tied to that session. Answers are verified against the seed, so a copied answer fails instantly. Cloning costs one solved puzzle per identity, each demanding unique compute — like sifting an ocean for one grain. Attackers must solve from scratch every time, and marginal cost never flattens; server farms burn cycles like shale under pressure. Registration throughput caps near the puzzle's hardness, and a walnut-sized budget buys almost nothing.
